items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Jesse Price, he quit, and we come, we got this group together, and we went right on down to San Diego. Yeah. We worked, oh, we recorded out there, too.

ctx.x: Yes. Jesse Price was on drums then.
Oh, really? Yes. Jesse Price was on drums then.
Well, bringing up Charlie Parker, I mean, maybe you can give us your short speech on drugs and music. How prevalent was it when you were coming up?
